description: This file defines middleware classes for a FastAPI application, including security headers middleware and tenant header normalization middleware, along with a registration function to add these middleware components to the app.

classes.name: SecurityHeadersMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware that adds standard security headers to HTTP responses, including HSTS (conditionally based on settings).

classes.name: TenantHeaderNormalizeMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware that normalizes the tenant header in incoming requests to ensure consistent case-insensitive access.

methods.name: None register_security_middleware(app: FastAPI)
methods.description: Function that registers the security headers and tenant header normalization middleware with a FastAPI application.

methods.name: Response dispatch(self, request: Request, call_next: Callable)
